title: Connected assistants (MCP)
description: Per ADR 0009: personal tokens with SHA-256 hashing and mandatory expiration for developer connections and AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex).
serverUrl: MCP server address (Streamable HTTP): {url}. Use a key from this workspace in the {header} header. The available tools depend on the key's scopes and your role; no tool changes data.
codex: Codex (~/.codex/config.toml, with the key in the GUIDU_MCP_TOKEN variable):
confirmRevoke: Revoke the key "{name}"? All connections and active assistants using this key will lose access immediately.
issuedNotice: Copy the token below and store it safely. For compliance reasons, it can never be viewed again after you close this message.
connectionDescription: Per ADR 0009: keys issued by the platform with mandatory expiration and secure SHA-256 hashing for AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex).
writeWarning: Warning: this scope lets the assistant propose changes that will require human approval on the platform.
keysNotice: Identified by prefix, with usage auditing
empty: No keys issued for this workspace. Create a key to connect MCP assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
issued: Key ''{name}'' issued. Save the secret shown below.

errors.invalidCreate: Invalid data for issuing the API key.
errors.scopeNotInPlan: The company's plan does not allow the {scope} scope.

workspace_read.label: Workspace overview (workspace:read)
workspace_read.desc: Read access to basic information and the workspace overview.

modules_read.label: Module status (modules:read)
modules_read.desc: View enabled modules and their operational status.

usage_read.label: Usage and quotas (usage:read)
usage_read.desc: View the usage summary, without access to secrets or restricted content.

executions_read.label: Executions and jobs (executions:read)
executions_read.desc: List and status of tasks and executions in the workspace.

members_read.label: Member list (members:read)
members_read.desc: View the members and memberships of the workspace.

proposals_write.label: Write proposals (proposals:write)
proposals_write.desc: Lets the assistant create operational proposals subject to human approval.

crm_read.label: CRM contacts (crm:read)
crm_read.desc: Read contacts of the CRM module, when the module is enabled.

crm_write.label: Write CRM contacts (crm:write)
crm_write.desc: Create and edit contacts through the REST API. In MCP, writes go through a proposal.

portfolio_read.label: Portfolio catalog (portfolio:read)
portfolio_read.desc: Search and look up items in UCP format (search_catalog, lookup_catalog, get_product). Only active, public items with a price.

portfolio_agent.label: Portfolio for the customer service agent (portfolio:agent)
portfolio_agent.desc: Agent view: includes price-on-request items and the AI rules (keywords, what never to say, safety).

portfolio_write.label: Write to the Portfolio (portfolio:write)
portfolio_write.desc: Create and edit items and variants through the REST API. In MCP, writes go through a proposal.
